item.title: Olivia Dean dominates the BRIT Awards with major wins
item.description: Olivia Dean was the big winner at the BRIT Awards. The Man I Need hitmaker took home four prizes as the ceremony took place in Manchester for the first time on Saturday night. Olivia took Song of the Year for Rein Me In - her duet with Sam Fender - at the start of the evening before going on to add the Best Pop Act, British Artist of the Year and British Album of the Year (for her record The Art of Loving) later in the evening. item.title: Audrey Hobert in Auckland this May
item.description: US singer-songwriter Audrey Hobert is heading to Aotearoa for the very first time, bringing her Staircase To Stardom Tour to Powerstation in Auckland. Don’t miss Audrey live across two all-ages, licensed R18 shows on Saturday, May 9, and Sunday, May 10, 2026. It’s her debut New Zealand visit and your chance to catch one of the most exciting rising voices in US pop up close and personal. Playing at Auckland's PowerStation on May 9th (SOLD OUT) and May 10th. Grab your tickets from FrontierTouring.
